useFor: Use for written content (docs, help panes, agent prompts). TypographyH3 is the 20px page or dialog title; TypographyP is body copy; TypographyMuted the line under a title; TypographyInlineCode a key, host or ID. Interfaces built from components rarely need these.
source: Figma 427:2715: page titles (Vault, Webhooks), dialog titles, the email body, inline hosts and keys
